name: CP Cep
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 17.86 days; its mean radius is 85.2 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CP Cep: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 85.2 +/- 3.5 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 55, Name='CP Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 177 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2198162651499971200 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CP Cep: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3073.5 +/- 120.1 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.702 +/- 0.05 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 17.9 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 85.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,074 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, CP Cep: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
